title: Boundary par payment route karo
instruction: Payment bundles route karo. Boundary included hai; usse upar voluntary lane. Yeh book-rule exercise hai, har retail case ki legal advice nahi.

pieces.label: Rupee coins: total ₹1,000
pieces.right: Exactly ₹1,000 'up to ₹1,000' ke andar hai; boundary included hai.
pieces.wrong: Boundary ko above-limit bolne se 'up to' ka meaning tootega; valid coins demonetized bhi nahi hain.

pieces.label: Rupee coins: ₹1,000 se zyada
pieces.right: Group valid hai, par amount ceiling cross karta hai: acceptance voluntary hai.
pieces.wrong: Within-limit lane coin ceiling mita degi; invalid lane validity aur amount-limit mix karegi.

pieces.label: 50-paise coins: total ₹10
pieces.right: ₹10 exactly limit par hai, isliye book-rule ke andar hai.
pieces.wrong: 50 paise below-50 demonetized group nahi; ₹10 boundary bhi included hai.

pieces.label: 50-paise coins: ₹10 se zyada
pieces.right: ₹10 ceiling cross hui; is group ko rupee coins ki ₹1,000 ceiling nahi milti.
pieces.wrong: ₹1,000 tak compulsory kehna wrong group ka limit lagaayega; coin khud demonetized nahi.

pieces.label: Below-50-paise coins ka payment
pieces.right: No-longer-legal-tender group hai; chhota amount bhi legal-tender claim restore nahi karta.
pieces.wrong: Chhota total dekhkar within-limit bhejne se demonetization ignore ho jaayega.

pieces.label: Valid banknotes: total ₹1,000 se zyada
pieces.right: Genuine aur valid banknotes unlimited category mein hain; coin ki ₹1,000 ceiling notes par nahi lagti.
pieces.wrong: Sirf total dekhkar voluntary lane bhejne se coin rule banknotes par transfer ho jaayega.

win: Chapter-game complete: value ka base, legal status, instrument aur amount check karke payment route kiya.
